oliver: quick handoff — prepping marketplace listing for LangChain + LlamaIndex adapters and a tiny gateway-orchestration example. need owners and a timeline.

rita: i'll take marketplace metadata + assets. need partner blurb, logos, and a 60s demo video.

kevin: i'll run perf harness on partner images and our Dedicated baseline. filed infra ticket INF-5012 for image ingestion.

maria: devex will author two quickstarts (LangChain + LlamaIndex) and a 12-line orchX DAG example. will make notebooks runnable in CI.

sam: confirm adapter contract: init(config), call(model, prompt, stream=False), health_check(). streaming required but must have non-stream fallback.

partners-bot: reminder: marketplace checklist requires `mou_signed`, `demo_video_url`, `support_contact`. See /ops/marketplace-checklist.md

kevin: sample smoke job will output JSON with p50/p95. i'll publish the template today.

lucia: legal note: need signed MOU + DPA link for EU data before public listing. i'll prepare templates.

devex-bot: uploaded quickstart notebook draft: https://internal.docs/notebooks/isv-mini-quickstarts.ipynb

rita: timeline proposal: 2 weeks to readiness, +1 week buffer for HW runs and legal. sync Mon 9am PT to triage blockers.

oliver: owners summary: rita (marketplace + assets), kevin (perf + infra), maria (quickstarts + CI tests), lucia (legal). post PRs and tickets; short replies here. thanks!
